structured_output.what_is_happening: This coin looks like it has already been rugged. When it was detected, the PumpSwap pool held about $66k of liquidity and the market cap was $54k. By the time the packet was collected, 3 minutes later, liquidity was $0.01. A direct DexScreener pair fetch shows the pool holds just 24.7 base tokens and 0.000055 SOL. The listed $214k market cap and +871% 1h price change are artifacts of a nearly empty pool, where a tiny trade moves the price a lot. They are not real demand. The token was not a pump.fun curve launch: the creator minted it and opened the PumpSwap pool 6 seconds later, and still holds 61% of supply. At least two other identical '💲SATAN' tokens were launched minutes before this one. That points to a serial deploy-and-drain pattern, not a real community coin.

narrative.description: A generic 'SATAN' meme with an emoji ticker. No cultural event, website, socials or X account was found.
narrative.why_spreading: The volume looks bot-driven and cyclical. GeckoTerminal counts 1,124 unique buyers but only 116 unique sellers, and buy/sell counts are nearly balanced every 5 minutes. None of this is organic narrative attention.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the most volume of the same-name clones, but there is no project behind any of them.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6Gfzrf...du61 and 5nRFSW...zePX both use the same '💲SATAN' symbol, were created 8 and 11 minutes earlier, and both have about $0 liquidity. AFER6N...pump is an older, dead Satan token.

authenticity.evidence: The creator holds 61%, and GMGN flags that same 61% as rat/entrapment trader share. GMGN also tags 16 bundler wallets. The liquidity went from $66k to $0.01 within minutes. There are no socials and no paid promotion. Several clone tokens were launched in quick succession.
authenticity.uncertainty: The DexScreener liquidity figure could in principle be a data glitch. But the raw pool reserves (24.7 tokens and 0.000055 SOL) confirm the pool is drained.

structural_risks: Pool liquidity is about $0.01, so the pool is effectively drained
The creator holds 61% of supply and one other wallet holds 10.5%
The listed price and market cap are meaningless with no liquidity behind them

structured_output.counterargument: A dead pool can occasionally be reseeded, and the DexScreener price could show a spike from a tiny trade. But a paper position bought into $0.01 of liquidity cannot realistically get a 2x fill. This is a rug under the trade rules.
unknowns: The exact transaction that drained the pool (not checked on-chain)
Whether the creator will reseed liquidity

source_coverage.notes: No socials in the packet. Searching the contract address and ticker returned nothing relevant. Research was kept short because the pool is already drained.

structured_output.thesis: Already rugged: pool liquidity went from about $66k to $0.01 within minutes of detection, and the creator holds 61%. The narrative is a fake-looking clone with no socials. I expect a total loss on entry.
